detector.description: Fishial YOLO26 nano v3, pretrained externally; no FeedWatch detection training. Full-frame proportional letterbox; independent of the feeding crop. 640 pilot missed small fish; 1280 pilot usable with misses/grouped boxes.

tracker.association: Hungarian IoU + normalized center distance, past constant-velocity prediction; never draw unmatched boxes

motion.description: Farneback on consecutive full grayscale frames at proportional 640 long edge, Gaussian 3x3; scale vectors back to source pixels and divide by actual timestamp delta. Image motion includes water, reflections and camera motion; no fish segmentation.
